jobs.occupation: Postdoc / Scientist in Space Instrumentation – ULTRASAT UV Camera (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: For our location in Zeuthen we are seeking:Postdoc / Scientist in Space Instrumentation – ULTRASAT UV CameraRemuneration Group 13 | Limited: 2 years | Start: 01.04.2027 | ID: APPO005/2026 | Deadline: 03.01.2027 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possibleDESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.ULTRASAT is a wide-field ultraviolet space telescope that will survey the sky for fast transients, including the counterparts of gravitational-wave events, supernovae and tidal disruption events. The satellite is built under the lead of the Israel Space Agency and the Weizmann Institute of Science. DESY develops, builds and tests the mission's UV camera, based on large-format CMOS sensors.You will characterise the ULTRASAT UV camera, help bring it to flight readiness and optimize it for space operations.About your role:- Test campaigns: designing and carrying out measurements of sensor and camera performance, including UV response, noise, and radiation hardness- Data analysis: developing analysis software and turning test data into performance and calibration results- Test laboratory: operating, maintaining and further developing the DESY UV test facilities- Mission work: contributing to camera commissioning and to ULTRASAT mission reviews, in close collaboration with our partners in IsraelYou will also have the opportunity to pursue your own research, either within the DESY ULTRASAT science team or with other groups of the astroparticle physics division.About you:- PhD in physics, electrical engineering, space engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience- Experience with instrumentation (ideally optical or UV sensors, or CMOS)- Strong programming skills in Python- Ability to work independently and in an international team- Good command of English- Experience in radiation or optical testing, as well as programming of hardware control of test stands is an advantageGood reasons to join:Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our staff are central to us, with gender equality forming a key part of this commitment. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities.
